names.note: Read out of saint.gr's line for 10 Ιουλίου, «Όσιοι Παρθένιος και Ευμένιος οι εν Γορτύνη της Νήσου Κρήτης», with the rank word left off. The page gives his baptismal name as Εμμανουήλ and his first monastic name as Μεθόδιος; Ευμένιος is the name he took at the great schema.

The heading of days.pravoslavie.ru’s name page 14469, «Евмений Гортинский, Кудумский, прп.», with the rank word after the last comma left off. The day line gives the bare forename in the genitive with the epithet in the plural, «Евмения (1920) и Парфения (1905) Гортинских», so the second byname is the name page’s. `fk.mjs` returns no other holder.

birth.note: saint.gr heads him «Οσιος Ευμενιος O Εν Γορτυνη Της Νησου Κρητης (1846 - 1920)» and its narrative: «το 1846 μ.Χ. γεννήθηκε και ο Ευμένιος, κατά κόσμον Εμμανουήλ».

death.note: saint.gr: «εκοιμήθη στις 12 Σεπτεμβρίου του 1920 μ.Χ.», and the page's heading closes the bracket at 1920.

source.text: Православный церковный календарь, Сретенский монастырь (days.pravoslavie.ru), 10 июля ст. ст. — «Прпп. Евмения (1920) и Парфения (1905) Гортинских.»

attestations.note: The day’s eighth entry, first name, and this folder’s man beyond doubt: the same menologion day its Greek row already keeps, the same Gortyna of Crete, the same Koudoumas — name page 14469 heads him «Евмений Гортинский, Кудумский, прп.», both of this folder’s bynames in one line — and «(1920)», which is EXACTLY the year of death this folder already carries off saint.gr. `dates` and `types` UNCHANGED. THE CALENDAR GIVES NO LIFE: the line links to the two names and to no reading. ONE ODDITY ON HIS NAME PAGE, RECORDED AND NOT ACTED ON: it lists «Дни памяти: 26 января (Новомуч.) , 10 июля» — the synaxis of the New Martyrs and Confessors of Russia beside his own day, for a Cretan hieromonk who died in his bed in 1920. His companion’s page, 14470, lists 10 июля alone. No `new-martyr` was written and the 26 января page was not opened; the line itself grades him «Прпп.», venerable, and nothing more. No hymn on the day page stands under either name. TWO ENTRIES OF THIS DAY WERE WITHHELD AND ARE NAMED IN THE REPORT, both folders already carrying a VENERATED russian row on another Julian day: `anthony-of-the-caves` on 2 сентября (three hymns on this page left uncopied) and `silouan-of-the-kyiv-caves` on 10 июня — whose own row-note already records that his name page lists 10 июля as a day it did not read, and whose two hymns were taken there. BRIEF-RUSSIAN §4 forbids a draft on such a folder and BRIEF.md §4 sanctions a second-day note; the author has not ruled, so nothing was written for either. LEFT OUT of this day: «Положение честной ризы Господа нашего Иисуса Христа в Москве (1625)», the laying up of the Lord’s robe, which is a feast and not a person, with its troparion, kontakion and величание; and the Konevskaya icon with its two hymns.
Not checked: doxologia.ro's calendar for the same civil day (1 October 2026).

source.text: saint.gr, το εορτολόγιο της 10ης Ιουλίου — «Όσιοι Παρθένιος και Ευμένιος οι εν Γορτύνη της Νήσου Κρήτης»

attestations.note: The life page heads «Τύπος εορτής: Σταθερή. Εορτάζει στις 10 Ιουλίου εκάστου έτους», the same day as the listing: the first church in the two brothers' honour was consecrated at Koudoumas on 10 July 1983 and the day was fixed as their memory then, and the Ecumenical Patriarchate entered them in the calendar of saints in 2007. **He is not the corpus's `eumenius-of-gortyna`**, although the Greek line calls both men «εν Γορτύνη»: that one is the seventh-century wonderworking bishop of Gortyna whom saint.gr itself keeps on 18 Σεπτεμβρίου and whose folder already carries a venerated Greek row for that day; this one is the monk born at Pitsidia in 1846, ordained priest in 1870, confessor of Koudoumas, who died on 12 September 1920. The see, the century and the brother settle it. The page gives his repose as 12 September and the memory as 10 July, which is the consecration day, not a second feast; one row per church is the schema, so the row is the day page read and the repose date is recorded here. No asterisk and no «Δεν είναι διασταυρωμένη» sentence. The page prints two apolytikia; the first names both brothers and is taken here, the second names Parthenius alone and is not.
Not checked: the Ohrid Prologue on pravoslavno.rs for the corresponding Julian day (1 October 2026).

hymns.text: Κουδουμᾶ τοῦ σεμνείου τούς νέους κτίτορας, τούς αὐταδέλφους ὁσίους ἐν τοῖς ἐσχάτοις καιροῖς ἐγκρατείας καί εὐχῆς βολαῖς ἐκλάμψαντας, θεῖον Εὐμένιον ᾠδαῖς καί Παρθένιον σοφόν, τιμῶντες ἀξιοχρέως ὑπέρ ὑμῶν τάς ἐντεύξεις πρός τόν Χριστόν αὐτῶν αἰτούμεθα.

source.text: saint.gr, Ἀπολυτίκιον, Ἦχος πλ. α’, Τόν συνάναρχον Λόγον — the first of two apolytikia on the shared page of «Όσιοι Παρθένιος και Ευμένιος οι εν Γορτύνη της Νήσου Κρήτης», and it names them both

english.text: Honouring as we ought the new founders of the monastery of Koudoumas, the brothers in the flesh, venerable ones who in these last times shone out with the shafts of abstinence and of prayer — divine Eumenius and wise Parthenius — we ask of them with songs their intercessions with Christ on your behalf.
